questions.question: Verify the ENS posts: the source calls Borel a professor from 1897 and director for ten years, but ENS identifies him as deputy director for sciences in 1910–1920, https://www.ens.psl.eu/en/node/7160 . Approve the title and sequence of appointments in both versions.

localizations.source: Verify the ENS posts: the source calls Borel a professor from 1897 and director for ten years, but ENS identifies him as deputy director for sciences in 1910–1920, https://www.ens.psl.eu/en/node/7160 . Approve the title and sequence of appointments in both versions.
localizations.ru: Сверить должности в Нормальной школе: исходник называет Бореля профессором с 1897 и директором десять лет; сама ENS указывает directeur adjoint sciences в 1910–1920: https://www.ens.psl.eu/en/node/7160 . Согласовать должность заместителя директора и последовательность назначений в обеих версиях.

questions.resolution: The posts and dates follow the [Academy of Sciences biography](https://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/dossiers/Borel/Borel_od1.htm) and the [ENS institutional history](https://www.ens.psl.eu/en/node/7160).
